Conformal prediction then provides finite-sample calibration guarantees for predictions derived from those posteriors, ensuring robustness against model misspecification. Finally, the state-transition matrix bridges static probabilistic models to dynamic systems, enabling temporal reasoning in both GSI's sequential decision-making (betting) and GSE's control problems (trajectory planning). This chain—from communication limits to dynamic state evolution—constitutes the minimal sovereign foundation for any agent operating in uncertain, evolving environments.
